
```{r}
#load the data
Data_set_1_clean <- read_rds("../data/02_df1_clean.rds")

```


### Initial data filtering

```{r}
  "Solyc03g095900",
  "Solyc03g089310",
  "Solyc09g010210"
)

#Selection of columns for matrix
heatmap_df <- Data_set_1_clean |>
  select(
  Gene_ID, Gene_Name,
    `FC_AC(P/G)`,
    `FC_TF18(P/G)`,
    `FC_rin(P/G)`,
    `FC_TF18_P/AC_P`,
    `FC_rin_P/AC_P`,
    `FC_TF18_G/AC_G`,
    `FC_rin_G/AC_G`
    ) |> 
  rename("AC_P/AC_G" = 3,
         "TF18_P/TF18_G" = 4,
         "rin_P/rin_G" = 5,
         "TF18_P/AC_P" = 6,
         "rin_P/AC_P" = 7,
         "TF18_G/AC_G" = 8,
         "rin_G/AC_G" = 9) |> 
  filter(Gene_ID %in% gene_order) |> # Only keep displayed genes
  mutate(Gene_ID = factor(Gene_ID, levels = rev(gene_order))) # order based on gene_order
```

### Convert to Matrix
```{r}
# Convert to numeric matrix for clustering
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_df |>
  select(-Gene_Name) |>
  column_to_rownames("Gene_ID") |>
  as.matrix()

# Hierarchical clustering of genes
hc <- hclust(
  dist(heatmap_mat, method = "euclidean"),
  method = "complete"
)
```

### Create Dendogram
```{r}
dhc <- as.dendrogram(hc)

data <- dendro_data(dhc, type = "rectangle")

p <- ggplot(segment(data)) + 
  
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) + 
  
  coord_flip() + 
  
  scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

p_dend <- p +
      theme_dendro()
```

### Fetch Gene-ID and -Name for Sample Labels 

```{r}
gene_labels <- heatmap_df |>
  
  distinct(Gene_ID, Gene_Name) |>
  
  mutate(label = paste(Gene_ID, Gene_Name)) |>
  
  select(Gene_ID, label) |>
  
  deframe() # converts data frame to vector
```


```{r}
cols_p <- colnames(heatmap_df[3:9])
```


### Create Heatmap
```{r}
p_heat <- heatmap_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Gene_ID, Gene_Name),
    names_to = "Fold_Changes",
    values_to = "vals"
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Fold_Changes, y = Gene_ID, fill = vals)) +
  
  geom_tile(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Set colour gradient
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-10,10),
    oob = scales::squish # set "out of boundary" values to be within the limits
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0), limits = cols_p) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right", expand = c(0, 0), labels = gene_labels) +
  
  labs(x = NULL, fill = "Fold Change\n(log2)") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # Remove grid
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    # Remove axis ticks 
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    
    # Position x axis
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    # Position y axis
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    
    legend.frame = element_rect(color ="black"), #,plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0) # remove extra space around plot
  )

p_heat
```

### Combine the plots
```{r}
# Combine dendrogram and heatmap using patchwork

p_combined <- (p_dend | p_heat ) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 5))
p_combined
```

### Save the plot with proper height and width
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/04_heatmap.png",
  plot = p_combined,
  width = 6,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
